blocks.text: Jab nitrile ko dilute sodium hydroxide solution ke saath garam kiya jata hai to carboxylic acid ka salt aur ammonia bante hain. Is salt mein dilute hydrochloric acid dalne (acidification) se free (azad) carboxylic acid mil jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Propanenitrile ko dilute sodium hydroxide ke saath garam karne par kaun si gas nikalti hai, aur organic product kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Ammonia (NH₃) gas; organic product sodium propanoate, CH₃CH₂COONa, jo HCl dalne par propanoic acid deta hai.

items: Nitriles R–CN; RX + KCN se bante hain (chapter 21).
Acid hydrolysis: RCOOH + NH₄Cl; alkaline hydrolysis: RCOONa + NH₃, phir HCl se RCOOH.
